events.title: Professional Development Day 2026
events.summary: Our biggest program day of the year. Scholars spend a Saturday working on resumes, career stories, and the skills that turn a degree into a first job. Volunteers keep the whole day moving - and get a front-row seat to why this work matters.
events.crew: Join Stacy, Bryen, Rachel, and 5 others who already grabbed a role - volunteers from 84.51, FEG Investment Advisors, Pinnacle Solutions Group, and Strategic Connexus.

roles.name: Breakout Lead: Craft a Standout Resume
roles.description: Help scholars create their first resume or refine an existing one so it communicates their experiences, strengths, and accomplishments more effectively. Facilitate both 45-minute rounds - Level Up provides the facilitation guide, talking points, and student activities in advance. 11:15 AM - 1:30 PM, lunch included. You're welcome to stay for the 2:00 close.

roles.description: Help scholars create their first resume or refine an existing one so it communicates their experiences, strengths, and accomplishments more effectively. events.title: Aiming for Opportunity
events.summary: Our sporting clays tournament brings Cincinnati business leaders together for a day on the course - and every station funds scholarships and coaching. Volunteers welcome shooters, support stations, and keep the day rolling.

events.title: Annual Finance Dinner
events.summary: An evening of real conversations about money - budgeting, loans, investing - shared over dinner with Cincinnati professionals. Volunteers host tables and help make money talk feel normal instead of scary.

events.title: Level Up Your Network
events.summary: The flagship event of Networking Month - scholars have called it our most impactful event yet. Speed networking, career exploration, and a room full of Cincinnati professionals ready to open doors. Your job? Be one of them.

events.title: End of Year Celebration
events.summary: We close the academic year by celebrating what our scholars accomplished - the milestones, the wins, and the people who backed them. Volunteers handle setup and check-in and help make the night feel special.

events.title: Urban Bourbon
events.summary: An invitation-only bourbon tasting that raises money for scholarships and coaching. A small crew of volunteers keeps check-in smooth and the evening running so guests can focus on the pours.

events.title: Match Day
events.summary: The day it all begins: scholars meet their coaches for the first time. Volunteers run check-in, welcome families, and help the introductions land - it's the foundation for everything that follows.
